mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tracking_summary ( tracking_number, booking_id, current_status, misrouted, last_event_at, created_at, updated_at, version ) VALUES ( #{trackingNumber}, #{bookingId}, #{currentStatus}, FALSE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE tracking_summary SET current_status = #{currentStatus}, current_unlocode = #{currentUnlocode}, current_voyage_number = #{currentVoyageNumber}, last_event_at = #{lastEventAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE tracking_number = #{trackingNumber}
UPDATE tracking_summary SET misrouted = TRUE, last_event_at = #{lastEventAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE tracking_number = #{trackingNumber}
UPDATE tracking_summary SET delivered_published_at = #{publishedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version = version + 1 WHERE tracking_number = #{trackingNumber} AND delivered_published_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tracking_summary ORDER BY updated_at DESC, tracking_number ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
